description: On the green bed surface, a smartphone is lying near a white charging cable, with a large white board leaning against the wall in the background. The right hand steadies and slightly slides the phone to the right while the left hand grips the cable plug, then the left hand pulls the plug straight out of the phone and releases it, leaving the phone as a right-hand object and the unplugged cable as a left-hand object briefly before the left hand lets go.
